interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Minimize the width of the driveway entrance to reduce the exposure of pedestrians to turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to provide an accessible path of travel across the street.

interventions.title: Driveway Design Reinforcement
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk material and level continue across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Tactile Warning Surfaces
interventions.description: Install truncated domes at curb ramps to assist visually impaired pedestrians in identifying the transition from sidewalk to roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street furniture zone to provide physical and psychological separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Furniture Zone/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Consolidate street furniture into a dedicated buffer zone or add a planting strip to separate pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
